en: First Book, Chapter on the Non-Drinker (Apāyimhavagga)
"A friend indeed is he who follows for seven steps, but a companion is he who follows for twelve."
Within a month or half a month one becomes a relative,
and beyond that, even one's own self; how then could I,
for the sake of my own happiness, [neglect others]?
"One should abandon even a long-cherished companion who is ill-fated.
Thus ends the third Jātaka, the Kāḷakaṇṇi-jātaka.
